name: new_wikitext2_benchmark
description: An updated/rehydrated version of the classic WikiText-2 benchmark for evaluating language models on next-token prediction and general language modeling. It measures model ability to model natural English text (perplexity) on a lightweight, standard corpus and can be used to compare different architectures and training recipes. The dataset is suitable for fast LM evaluation and ablation studies.
reputation: Derived from the well-known WikiText-2 corpus, it is a widely recognized lightweight benchmark for language modeling with moderate community adoption for quick LM evaluations.
